zh.name: 旅
zh.note: 旅成員：右袖戴旅章，下面地域章、區章並排；戴旅巾。

en.name: Group
en.note: Group members: Group Badge on the right sleeve with the Region and District Badges side by side below; Group neckerchief.

zh.name: 區
zh.note: 區幹部、會務委員：右袖戴香港肩章，下面地域章、區章並排；戴會巾。

en.name: District
en.note: District cadre and lay members: Hong Kong shoulder title on the right sleeve with the Region and District Badges side by side below; Association neckerchief.

zh.name: 地域
zh.note: 地域幹部、會務委員：右袖戴香港肩章，下面只戴地域章（置中）；戴會巾。

en.name: Region
en.note: Regional cadre and lay members: Hong Kong shoulder title on the right sleeve with only the Region Badge below (centred); Association neckerchief.

zh.name: 總部
zh.note: 總會總部幹部、會務委員：右袖戴香港肩章，下面只戴總會總部章（置中）；戴會巾。

en.name: Headquarters
en.note: Headquarters cadre and lay members: Hong Kong shoulder title on the right sleeve with only the Association Headquarters Badge below (centred); Association neckerchief.

zh.name: 地域總監
zh.note: 職級同助理香港總監：肩章、帽章一樣（用戶指示）

en.name: Regional Commissioner
en.note: Same rank as Assistant Chief Commissioner: same epaulette and cap badge (user instruction)

zh.name: 編號 1 禮服
zh.note: 已宣誓成年成員出席典禮及儀式（會操、週年大會、就職禮、婚禮、喪禮）、國際及社區活動時穿著（主辦單位冇安排就著編號 3）。草青色四袋長袖上衣（有肩帶）、杏色長袖恤衫、深綠色領帶、棕色皮帶；男：草青色長褲、黑短襪、綁帶黑皮鞋；女：草青色半截裙（及膝）、肉色尼龍襪褲、非綁帶黑色中跟皮鞋。只可以戴基本徽章同 P.57 列明嘅可選項目。

en.name: No. 1 Dress uniform
en.note: Worn by invested adults at ceremonies (parades, AGMs, investitures, weddings, funerals), international and community events (No. 3 applies if the organiser sets nothing). Grass-green four-pocket long-sleeve jacket (shoulder straps), beige long-sleeve shirt, dark green tie, brown belt; men: grass-green trousers, black short socks, black laced shoes; women: grass-green knee-length skirt, flesh nylon tights, black non-laced medium-heel shoes. Only the basic badges and the optional items listed on p.57.

zh.name: 編號 2 晚禮服
zh.note: 已宣誓成年成員出席童軍領袖聚餐（Mess Night）及餐舞會時穿著；夏季白上衣、冬季黑上衣（請柬列明）。短身晚禮服上衣（翻領各有一個銀色童軍徽，肩帶、袖口有銀色童軍鈕）、白色長袖恤衫（冇花邊）、男黑色煲呔／女黑色女裝領結、紫色絲質腰封；男：黑色長褲（冇袋、兩邊紫色絲質間條）、黑短襪、黑色平面皮鞋；女：黑色長裙、肉色襪褲、黑色平面高跟鞋。黑色硬帽連銀色帽章、金屬職級肩章。

en.name: No. 2 Evening dress
en.note: Worn by invested adults at Scouters' Mess Nights and dinner dances; white jacket in summer, black in winter (stated on the invitation). Short mess jacket (a silver Scout emblem on each lapel, silver Scout buttons on the straps and cuffs), white long-sleeve shirt (no frills), men black bow tie / women black ladies' bow, purple silk cummerbund; men: black trousers (no pockets, purple silk side stripes), black short socks, black plain shoes; women: black long skirt, flesh tights, black plain high heels. Black hard hat with silver cap badge, metal rank epaulettes.

zh.name: 編號 3 常規制服
zh.note: 領巾連童軍巾圈；男：長褲、黑短襪、綁帶皮鞋；女：半截裙、肉色襪褲、非綁帶中跟皮鞋。

en.name: No. 3 Regular uniform
en.note: Neckerchief with Scout woggle; men: trousers, black short socks, laced shoes; women: skirt, flesh-coloured tights, non-laced medium-heel shoes.

zh.name: 編號 4 領帶制服
zh.note: 領帶代替領巾（陸上深綠色、海童軍黑色、空童軍深藍色）；其餘同編號 3。

en.name: No. 4 Tie uniform
en.note: A tie instead of the neckerchief (dark green; Sea black; Air dark blue); otherwise as No. 3.

zh.name: 編號 5 男性成員短褲制服
zh.note: 短褲、長襪（陸上深草青色；海／空深藍色）、綁帶皮鞋；領巾連童軍巾圈。

en.name: No. 5 Men's shorts uniform
en.note: Shorts, long socks (dark grass green; Sea/Air dark blue), laced shoes; neckerchief with Scout woggle.

zh.name: 編號 6 女性成員長褲制服
zh.note: 長褲、黑短襪、綁帶皮鞋；領巾連童軍巾圈；唔可以戴金邊硬帽（戴軟帽）。

en.name: No. 6 Women's trousers uniform
en.note: Trousers, black short socks, laced shoes; neckerchief with Scout woggle; the gold-edged hard hat may not be worn (beret instead).

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 男：深綠色軟帽連職級帽章，帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方二釐米。女（編號 3、4）：深綠色金邊硬帽連職級帽章，帽章喺硬帽右方、同右耳成一直線，帽邊離眼眉約四釐米；女性成員著常規制服或領帶制服而唔戴硬帽時可戴深綠色軟帽；著長褲（編號 6）唔可以戴硬帽。深資童軍領袖（同教練員）戴棗紅色軟帽；女性深資童軍領袖著編號 3、4 而唔戴硬帽時可戴棗紅色軟帽。

en.name: Cap / beret / hard hat
en.rule: Men: dark green beret with the rank cap badge, worn on the black band 2 cm above the left eye. Women (No. 3, 4): dark green gold-edged hard hat with the rank cap badge on the right side, in line with the right ear, the brim about 4 cm above the eyebrows; women in the regular or tie uniform may wear the dark green beret instead of the hard hat; the hard hat may not be worn with trousers (No. 6). Venture Scout leaders (and instructors) wear the maroon beret; women Venture Scout leaders in No. 3, 4 may wear the maroon beret instead of the hard hat.

modelNote.zh: 職級帽章 = 帽章頂嘅顏色帽纓，顏色跟職級（P.103–104）；圖案取自手冊 P.103–104 表格（細圖放大）。方塊人嘅軟帽、硬帽只係示意形狀：硬帽係深綠色方盒、頂邊同帽邊有金邊。
modelNote.en: The rank cap badge is the coloured plume above the cap badge, its colour set by rank (pp.103–104); artwork from the Handbook pp.103–104 table (small images enlarged). The blocky beret and hard hat are only indicative: the hard hat is a dark green box with gold edging round the top and brim.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 杏色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Beige, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

modelNote.zh: 短袖約喺手踭上 5 釐米（P.88）。
modelNote.en: Short sleeves end about 5 cm above the elbow (p.88).

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙／短褲
zh.rule: 編號 3、4：男草青色長褲（兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶）；女草青色半截裙（側袋、無褶、及膝）。編號 5：男草青色短褲（兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶）。編號 6：女草青色長褲（兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶）。

en.name: Trousers / skirt / shorts
en.rule: No. 3, 4: men grass-green trousers (two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated); women grass-green skirt (side pockets, no pleats, knee length). No. 5: men grass-green shorts (two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated). No. 6: women grass-green trousers (two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated).

modelNote.zh: 短褲約喺膝頭中間上 10 釐米（P.88）。半截裙一件過，中間冇線。
modelNote.en: Shorts end about 10 cm above mid-knee (p.88). The skirt is one piece with no centre line.

zh.name: 皮帶
zh.rule: 棕色（連童軍徽皮帶扣）。

en.name: Belt
en.rule: Brown, with the Scout badge buckle.

modelNote.zh: 皮帶扣只畫銀色方塊示意。
modelNote.en: The buckle is a plain silver block.

zh.name: 襪
zh.rule: 編號 3、4：男黑色短襪；女肉色、尼龍、無花、襪褲。編號 5：深草青色長襪。編號 6：黑色短襪。

en.name: Socks
en.rule: No. 3, 4: men black short socks; women flesh-coloured plain nylon tights. No. 5: dark grass-green long socks. No. 6: black short socks.

zh.name: 皮鞋
zh.rule: 編號 3、4：男黑色、無花紋、綁帶；女黑色、無花紋、非綁帶、中跟。編號 5、6：黑色、無花紋、綁帶。

en.name: Shoes
en.rule: No. 3, 4: men black, plain, laced; women black, plain, not laced, medium heel. No. 5, 6: black, plain, laced.

modelNote.zh: 中跟皮鞋沿用深資／樂行童軍嘅方塊造型（腳弓位留空、鞋面見肉色襪褲）。
modelNote.en: The medium-heel shoe reuses the Venture/Rover block build (hollow arch, tights showing on top).

zh.name: 領巾
zh.rule: 編號 3、5、6：領巾連童軍巾圈。旅成員戴旅巾；總會總部、地域及區幹部（包括總領袖、副總領袖、贊助人、副贊助人、各級總監及領袖）、會務委員、專業領袖及受薪職員戴會巾（深綠色，領巾尖繡香港章，捲巾方式）。木章持有人可戴基維爾領巾（捲巾方式）。領巾尾喺肚臍附近，唔可以越過皮帶扣。

en.name: Neckerchief
en.rule: No. 3, 5, 6: neckerchief with the Scout woggle. Group members wear the Group neckerchief; Headquarters, Regional and District cadre (including the Chief Scout, Deputy Chief Scout, patrons, commissioners and scouters), lay members, professional scouters and salaried staff wear the Association neckerchief (dark green, Hong Kong Badge embroidered at the point, rolled). Wood Badge holders may wear the Gilwell neckerchief (rolled). The ends sit near the navel and may not pass the belt buckle.

modelNote.zh: 會巾領巾尖嘅香港章用手冊 P.93 香港章圖案示意；基維爾領巾尖嘅格仔布取自手冊 P.109 圖。旅巾顏色可以喺服裝分頁揀。
modelNote.en: The Hong Kong Badge at the Association neckerchief point uses the Handbook p.93 artwork; the tartan patch on the Gilwell neckerchief is from the Handbook p.109 figure. The Group neckerchief colours can be picked in the Outfit tab.

zh.name: 巾圈
zh.rule: 童軍巾圈（啡色皮巾圈）。完成木章訓練系統第 4 階段（基本在職訓練）嘅成年成員可戴基維爾巾圈；領袖訓練員、助理領袖訓練主任及領袖訓練主任戴附有「斧頭木」金屬訓練隊標誌嘅基維爾巾圈。

en.name: Woggle
en.rule: Scout woggle (brown leather). Adults who have completed Stage 4 (basic in-service training) of the Wood Badge Training System may wear the Gilwell woggle; Leader Trainers, Assistant Leader Trainers in Charge and Leader Trainers in Charge wear the Gilwell woggle with the metal “axe and log” Training Team emblem.

modelNote.zh: 基維爾巾圈（土耳其結）用啡色方塊加結紋示意；斧頭木標誌用銀色小方塊示意。
modelNote.en: The Gilwell woggle (Turk's head) is a brown block with a knot pattern; the axe-and-log emblem is a small silver block.

zh.name: 木章
zh.rule: 完成木章訓練系統第 6 階段（高級在職訓練）並獲頒木章嘅成年成員可佩戴：皮繩連兩顆木珠穿過頸項，掛喺領巾前面，皮繩喺頸後藏喺領巾下面；領帶制服掛喺領帶前面。助理領袖訓練主任、領袖訓練主任分別戴三顆、四顆木珠。唔可以喺晚禮服上佩戴。

en.name: Wood Badge
en.rule: Adults who have completed Stage 6 (advanced in-service training) and been awarded the Wood Badge: a leather thong with two beads round the neck, hanging in front of the neckerchief, the thong hidden under the neckerchief at the back; with the tie uniform it hangs in front of the tie. Assistant Leader Trainers in Charge and Leader Trainers in Charge wear three and four beads. Not worn with evening dress.

modelNote.zh: 木珠數目跟職級自動轉。
modelNote.en: The number of beads follows the rank automatically.

zh.name: 領帶（編號 4）
zh.rule: 編號 4 領帶制服：深綠色領帶代替領巾；領帶尖喺皮帶扣上面。

en.name: Tie (No. 4)
en.rule: No. 4 tie uniform: a dark green tie instead of the neckerchief; the tip sits at the top of the belt buckle.

zh.name: 禮服上衣（編號 1）
zh.rule: 草青色、長袖、前面四個袋（兩個胸袋、兩個下袋，有袋蓋）、四粒鈕、肩帶；入面著杏色長袖恤衫（兩胸袋、肩帶）、深綠色領帶。男女款式一樣，女裝下身係草青色半截裙（側袋、冇褶、及膝）。

en.name: Dress jacket (No. 1)
en.rule: Grass green, long sleeves, four front pockets (two chest and two lower, with flaps), four buttons, shoulder straps; worn over the beige long-sleeve shirt (two chest pockets, straps) and dark green tie. Same cut for men and women; women wear the grass-green skirt (side pocket, no pleats, knee length).

modelNote.zh: 方塊人嘅禮服上衣用同褲同一隻草青色（手冊：同布料）；V 位見到恤衫領同領帶，下襬包住褲頭。四個袋同肩帶只係示意。
modelNote.en: The blocky dress jacket uses the same grass green as the trousers (Handbook: same fabric); the V shows the shirt collar and tie and the hem covers the waistband. Pockets and straps are indicative.

zh.name: 晚禮服上衣（編號 2）
zh.rule: 短身上衣：夏季白色、冬季黑色；翻領（青果領）各有一個銀色童軍徽；肩帶同袖口有銀色童軍鈕；前面敞開，見到白色長袖恤衫（冇花邊）同紫色絲質腰封。

en.name: Mess jacket (No. 2)
en.rule: Short jacket: white in summer, black in winter; a silver Scout emblem on each (shawl) lapel; silver Scout buttons on the straps and cuffs; worn open over the white long-sleeve shirt (no frills) and purple silk cummerbund.

modelNote.zh: 翻領銀色童軍徽圖案取自手冊 P.208–211 金屬肩章入面嘅銀色童軍徽（P.205 嘅翻領圖太細）。
modelNote.en: The lapel emblem artwork is the silver Scout emblem from the metal epaulettes on pp.208–211 (the p.205 lapel drawing is too small).

zh.name: 煲呔／女裝領結
zh.rule: 男：黑色煲呔；女：黑色女裝領結。

en.name: Bow tie / ladies' bow
en.rule: Men: black bow tie; women: black ladies' bow.

zh.name: 腰封
zh.rule: 紫色絲質腰封。

en.name: Cummerbund
en.rule: Purple silk cummerbund.

zh.name: 晚禮服長褲／長裙
zh.rule: 男：黑色長褲（冇袋），兩邊褲側有紫色絲質間條，黑短襪、黑色平面皮鞋；女：黑色長裙、肉色襪褲、黑色平面高跟鞋。

en.name: Evening trousers / long skirt
en.rule: Men: black trousers (no pockets) with a purple silk stripe down each side, black short socks, black plain shoes; women: black long skirt, flesh tights, black plain high heels.

modelNote.zh: 女裝高跟鞋沿用方塊人嘅中跟皮鞋造型示意。
modelNote.en: The women's high heels reuse the blocky medium-heel shoe as an indication.

zh.name: 晚禮服黑色硬帽
zh.rule: 男：黑色有帽舌硬帽，前面銀色帽章；帽舌邊飾跟職級（銀色橡葉、銀繩、冇邊飾、金色橡葉、金繩），見硬帽編號（UM01–06、LM01–04）。女：黑色有邊硬帽連銀色帽章，編號同男裝一樣但 M 改做 F（例：UM03 → UF03）。

en.name: Evening dress black hard hat
en.rule: Men: black peaked hard hat with a silver cap badge in front; the peak trim follows the rank (silver oak leaves, silver cord, plain, gold oak leaves, gold cord) — see hat codes UM01–06, LM01–04. Women: black brimmed hard hat with the silver cap badge; same codes with M changed to F (e.g. UM03 → UF03).

modelNote.zh: 帽章圖案取自手冊 P.208 硬帽圖；帽舌邊飾按 P.206–211 圖示意（方塊造型）。
modelNote.en: The cap badge artwork is from the p.208 hat drawing; the peak trim is indicated from pp.206–211 (blocky shapes).

zh.name: 海童軍領袖
zh.note: 海童軍領袖制服編號 3–6（手冊 P.70–75）：徽章同擺位同陸上領袖一樣；帽、恤衫、褲／裙、長襪、領帶唔同。

en.name: Sea Scout leaders
en.note: Sea Scout leader uniforms No. 3–6 (Handbook pp.70–75): the same badges in the same places as land leaders; the cap, shirt, trousers/skirt, long socks and tie differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 海童軍男領袖白頂帽／海童軍女領袖白頂帽，連海童軍領袖帽章：帽章戴喺白頂同黑色帽邊中間前面中央。帽邊喺眼眉上方約二釐米，同水平線看齊。

en.name: Cap / beret / hard hat
en.rule: Sea Scout male / female leader's white-top cap with the Sea Scout leader cap badge, worn front centre between the white top and the black band. The brim sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows, level.

modelNote.zh: 海童軍領袖帽章（唔係職級帽章）圖案取自手冊 P.105。方塊人嘅白頂帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: The Sea Scout leader cap badge (not a rank cap badge) artwork is from Handbook p.105. The blocky cap is only indicative.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 白色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: White, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙／短褲
zh.rule: 深藍色：編號 3、4 男長褲、女半截裙（及膝）；編號 5 男短褲；編號 6 女長褲。

en.name: Trousers / skirt / shorts
en.rule: Dark blue: No. 3, 4 men trousers, women skirt (knee length); No. 5 men shorts; No. 6 women trousers.

zh.name: 襪
zh.rule: 編號 3、4：男黑色短襪；女肉色尼龍襪褲。編號 5：深藍色長襪。編號 6：黑色短襪。

en.name: Socks
en.rule: No. 3, 4: men black short socks; women flesh-coloured nylon tights. No. 5: dark blue long socks. No. 6: black short socks.

zh.name: 領帶（編號 4）
zh.rule: 海童軍領袖戴黑色領帶。

en.name: Tie (No. 4)
en.rule: Sea Scout leaders wear the black tie.

zh.name: 空童軍領袖
zh.note: 空童軍領袖制服編號 3–6（手冊 P.76–81）：徽章同擺位同陸上領袖一樣；帽、恤衫、褲／裙、長襪、領帶唔同。

en.name: Air Scout leaders
en.note: Air Scout leader uniforms No. 3–6 (Handbook pp.76–81): the same badges in the same places as land leaders; the beret, shirt, trousers/skirt, long socks and tie differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 灰藍色軟帽連職級帽章（男女同款），帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方二釐米。

en.name: Cap / beret / hard hat
en.rule: Grey-blue beret with the rank cap badge (men and women), worn on the black band 2 cm above the left eye.

modelNote.zh: 方塊人嘅軟帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: The blocky beret is only indicative.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 淺藍色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Light blue, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 長褲／半截裙／短褲
zh.rule: 深藍色：編號 3、4 男長褲、女半截裙（及膝）；編號 5 男短褲；編號 6 女長褲。

en.name: Trousers / skirt / shorts
en.rule: Dark blue: No. 3, 4 men trousers, women skirt (knee length); No. 5 men shorts; No. 6 women trousers.

zh.name: 襪
zh.rule: 編號 3、4：男黑色短襪；女肉色尼龍襪褲。編號 5：深藍色長襪。編號 6：黑色短襪。

en.name: Socks
en.rule: No. 3, 4: men black short socks; women flesh-coloured nylon tights. No. 5: dark blue long socks. No. 6: black short socks.

zh.name: 領帶（編號 4）
zh.rule: 空童軍領袖戴深藍色領帶。

en.name: Tie (No. 4)
en.rule: Air Scout leaders wear the dark blue tie.

zh.name: 世界童軍會員章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 童軍成員佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣（成年成員適用）左胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: World Membership Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Worn centred on the left chest pocket of the uniform shirt or dress jacket (adults), or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 4 cm（同其他支部一樣）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 cm diameter (as for the other sections).

zh.name: 香港章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 樂行童軍及成年成員佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣（成年成員適用）右胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: Hong Kong Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's right chest pocket.
en.quote: Rover Scouts and adult members wear it centred on the right chest pocket of the uniform shirt or dress jacket (adults), or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 5.6 cm（P.93 圖案比例）。成年成員同樂行童軍一樣戴喺右胸袋中央（P.93 第 3 點、P.172 附圖），唔係青少年支部嘅左袋蓋上面。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 5.6 cm (p.93 artwork proportions). Adults, like Rover Scouts, wear it centred on the right pocket (p.93 item 3, p.172 figure), not above the left flap as the youth sections do.

zh.name: 香港肩章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 總會總部、地域及區幹部（包括總領袖、副總領袖、贊助人、副贊助人、各級總監及領袖）、會務委員、專業領袖及受薪職員佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 總部、地域、區層級先戴；旅成員改戴旅章。

en.name: Hong Kong Shoulder Title
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Headquarters, Regional and District cadre (including the Chief Scout, Deputy Chief Scout, patrons, commissioners and scouters), lay members, professional scouters and salaried staff wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Headquarters, Region and District levels; Group members wear the Group Badge instead.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm（同旅章一樣大，P.94 圖案比例約 4.1 : 1）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm (the same as the Group Badge; the p.94 artwork is about 4.1 : 1).

zh.name: 旅章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 旅成員佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣（成年成員適用）右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 旅層級先戴；由所屬旅提供。

en.name: Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Group members wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt or dress jacket (adults), or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Group level only; supplied by the Group.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.94：新成立旅嘅旅章不小過 8.5 × 2 cm、不大過 10.5 × 2.5 cm；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm。圖案係手冊示例（2222 旅）。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.94: a new Group's badge is between 8.5 × 2 cm and 10.5 × 2.5 cm; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm. The artwork is the handbook example (2222th Group).

zh.name: 總會總部章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，香港肩章下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 總會總部幹部（包括各級總監及領袖）及會務委員佩戴在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章下方二釐米中央位置。香港訓練隊隊員依所屬服務單位佩戴總會總部章／地域章。
zh.conditions: 總部層級先戴。

en.name: Association Headquarters Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title.
en.quote: Headquarters cadre (including commissioners and scouters) and lay members wear it centred 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt. Hong Kong Training Team members wear the Association Headquarters Badge or Region Badge of the unit they serve.
en.conditions: Headquarters level only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 3.8 × 5 cm（同地域章、區章一樣，P.95 圖案比例相近）。只得一個章，放中間（用戶指示）。唔可以戴喺毛衣上。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 3.8 × 5 cm (as the Region/District Badges; the p.95 artwork is similar). A single badge, centred (user instruction). Not worn on the sweater.

zh.name: 地域章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，香港肩章／旅章下方 2 釐米；同區章並排時地域章在前（靠穿著者前面），兩章相距 1 釐米；地域層級只戴地域章，置中。
zh.quote: 地域幹部（包括各級總監及領袖）及會務委員佩戴所屬地域章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章下方二釐米中央位置。區幹部（包括各級總監及領袖）、會務委員及旅成員同時佩戴所屬地域章及區章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章／旅章下方二釐米中央位置；地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。
zh.conditions: 旅、區、地域層級；跟所屬區嘅地域。

en.name: Region Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title / Group Badge; beside the District Badge it goes in front (toward the wearer's front), 1 cm apart; at Region level only the Region Badge, centred.
en.quote: Regional cadre (including commissioners and scouters) and lay members wear their Region Badge centred 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title on the right sleeve. District cadre, lay members and Group members wear both the Region and District Badges centred 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title / Group Badge; Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.conditions: Group, District and Region levels; the Region of the picked District.

modelNote.zh: 香港肩章同旅章一樣高（9 × 2.2 cm），所以兩款都係喺佢下面 2 cm。圖案跟揀咗嘅區轉做所屬地域；地域層級揀所屬地域入面任何一區就得。只得一個（地域層級、總會總部屬下嘅區，或者熄咗區章）就放中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: The Hong Kong shoulder title is the same height as the Group Badge (9 × 2.2 cm), so either way it sits 2 cm below. The artwork follows the Region of the picked District; at Region level pick any District in that Region. When it is alone (Region level, a District under AHQ, or the District Badge off) it is centred (user instruction).

zh.name: 區章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，香港肩章／旅章下方 2 釐米；喺地域章後面，相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。地域章及區章……標準尺寸是 3.8 釐米（闊）× 5 釐米（高）。
zh.conditions: 旅、區層級；揀返自己所屬嘅區。

en.name: District Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Hong Kong shoulder title / Group Badge; behind the Region Badge, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart. The standard size of the Region and District Badges is 3.8 cm wide × 5 cm high.
en.conditions: Group and District levels; pick your own District.

modelNote.zh: 可以揀全港所有區；未揀區就用手冊示例色塊。
modelNote.en: Every District can be picked; with none picked it uses the handbook example block.

zh.name: 職級肩章
zh.place: 雙肩肩帶上，緊貼肩帶末端（膊頭）。
zh.quote: 成年成員依照本身職級而佩戴該級帽章及肩章。不同顏色的帽章，以及不同顏色及圖樣的肩章標示不同職級。肩章套在制服恤衫、禮服上衣或制服毛衣雙肩肩帶上，緊貼肩帶末端。
zh.conditions: 跟所揀職級；喺徽章分頁頂揀單位層級同職級。

en.name: Rank epaulettes
en.place: On both shoulder straps, tight against the end of the strap (at the shoulder).
en.quote: Adult members wear the cap badge and epaulettes of their rank. Different cap badge colours, and different epaulette colours and patterns, mark different ranks. The epaulettes slide onto both shoulder straps of the uniform shirt, dress jacket or sweater, tight against the end of the strap.
en.conditions: Follows the picked rank; pick the level and rank at the top of the Badges tab.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4.6 cm（橫跨肩帶，肩帶闊 4.4 cm）× 3.65 cm（P.103–104 圖案比例）。P.172 袖圖：肩章喺肩帶膊頭嗰頭，徽號向衣領。圖案取自手冊 P.103–104 表格（細圖放大）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4.6 cm (across the 4.4 cm strap) × 3.65 cm (pp.103–104 artwork proportions). P.172 sleeve figure: the epaulette sits at the shoulder end of the strap with the emblem pointing to the collar. Artwork from the Handbook pp.103–104 table (small images enlarged).

zh.name: 「R」字樣別針（退休）
zh.place: 雙肩職級肩章下方（近膊頭）。
zh.quote: 退休領袖／總監佩戴其退休前最高職級帽章及肩章，並在肩章下方位置佩上「R」字樣（「R」指「Retired 退休」）別針。香港訓練隊隊員假若獲香港總監批准延長退休年限，在續任期內，肩章不需佩上「R」字樣別針。穿著晚禮服時，不需佩上「R」字樣別針。
zh.conditions: 退休領袖／總監；職級揀退休前最高職級。

en.name: “R” pin (retired)
en.place: On both rank epaulettes, below the emblem (toward the shoulder).
en.quote: Retired scouters/commissioners wear the cap badge and epaulettes of their highest rank before retirement, with an “R” pin (“R” for “Retired”) below on the epaulette. Hong Kong Training Team members whose retirement is extended by the Chief Commissioner do not add the R pin during the extension. The R pin is not worn with evening dress.
en.conditions: Retired scouters/commissioners; pick the highest rank held.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.105 圖：「R」喺肩章徽號下面。模型照圖放喺肩章近膊頭嗰半；尺寸跟圖案比例估計。圖案取自 P.105。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.105 figure: the “R” sits below the emblem on the epaulette. The model puts it on the shoulder half of the epaulette as drawn; size estimated from the artwork. Artwork from p.105.

zh.name: 優異旅團章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方中央，為期一年。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方中央位置，為期一年。有紅、紫和粉藍等三種顏色，每年輪流使用。
zh.conditions: 「優異旅團獎勵計劃」獲獎旅團嘅領袖、教練員及團員；為期一年。旅層級先有。

en.name: Meritorious Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred above the sleeve-hem seam, for one year.
en.quote: Worn centred above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt, for one year. Comes in red, purple and light blue, used in turn each year.
en.conditions: Leaders, instructors and members of a Group awarded under the Meritorious Group Scheme; for one year. Group level only.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2 cm（P.159 圖案比例）。P.172 附圖：成年成員嘅優異旅團章喺右袖最下。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2 cm (p.159 artwork proportions). P.172 figure: for adults it is lowest on the right sleeve.

zh.epaulette: 紫色圓章、銀星、銀色橡葉環

en.epaulette: purple disc, silver star, silver oak wreath

zh.name: 金屬職級肩章（晚禮服）
zh.place: 雙肩肩帶上，蓋住成條肩帶，銀鈕近衣領。
zh.quote: 穿著晚禮服時佩戴黑色硬帽連銀色帽章及金屬職級肩章。夏季穿著白色上衣、冬季穿著黑色上衣。
zh.conditions: 晚禮服先戴；跟所揀職級，顏色跟夏季（白）／冬季（黑）上衣。

en.name: Metal rank epaulettes (evening dress)
en.place: On both shoulder straps, covering the strap, silver button toward the collar.
en.quote: With evening dress, wear the black hard hat with the silver cap badge and the metal rank epaulettes. The white jacket is worn in summer and the black jacket in winter.
en.conditions: Evening dress only; follows the picked rank, white or black to match the summer / winter jacket.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4.6 cm 闊（橫跨肩帶）× 11.6 cm（P.206–211 圖案比例），由膊頭向衣領蓋住肩帶。圖案取自手冊 P.206–211。手冊冇列「受薪職員」嘅金屬肩章，模型暫用專業領袖（執行幹事）款，待確認。總幹事、副總幹事、助理總幹事戴 UM06 硬帽，模型嘅「專業領袖」用 UM04（執行幹事）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4.6 cm wide (across the strap) × 11.6 cm (pp.206–211 artwork proportions), covering the strap from the shoulder toward the collar. Artwork from pp.206–211. The Handbook lists no metal epaulette for salaried staff; the model uses the professional (executive officer) one for now, pending confirmation. The Chief / Deputy / Assistant Executive Commissioners wear the UM06 hat; the model's “professional scouter” uses UM04 (executive officers).

zh.name: 布質名牌
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋中央、鈕扣上面。
zh.quote: 童軍成員（小童軍除外）可在制服上佩戴繡有中、英文姓名的綠底黃字布質名牌，佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣左胸袋袋蓋中央及鈕扣對上位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 可選；喺下面輸入姓名。

en.name: Cloth name tag
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest-pocket flap, above the button.
en.quote: Members (except Grasshopper Scouts) may wear a green cloth name tag embroidered in yellow with their Chinese and English names, centred on the left chest-pocket flap above the button of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Optional; type the name below.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 7.5 × 1.6 cm（P.128 圖案比例）。綠底黃字跟 P.128 示例「童君好 KH TUNG」；輸入嘅姓名用瀏覽器字型畫。活動名牌同樣戴喺左胸袋袋蓋中央（P.123），款式由活動決定，模型冇畫。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 7.5 × 1.6 cm (p.128 artwork proportions). Green with yellow lettering as in the p.128 sample “童君好 KH TUNG”; the typed name uses the browser font. The activity name badge goes in the same place (p.123) but its design depends on the event, so it is not drawn.

zh.name: 喪禮黑布
zh.place: 穿著者左袖、手肘上方，闊 10 cm。
zh.quote: 童軍成員為表示哀悼或在參加喪禮期間，可在制服恤衫、禮服上衣或制服毛衣左袖手肘上方位置佩戴黑布。成年成員佩戴闊十釐米黑布。
zh.conditions: 可選；表示哀悼或參加喪禮時。

en.name: Mourning band
en.place: Wearer's left sleeve, above the elbow, 10 cm wide.
en.quote: To show mourning or while attending a funeral, members may wear a black band on the left sleeve above the elbow of the uniform shirt, dress jacket or sweater. Adults wear a band 10 cm wide.
en.conditions: Optional; for mourning or funerals.

modelNote.zh: 闊 10 cm 跟手冊 P.162；「手肘上方」模型用手肘上面 1 cm（手冊冇寫距離）。黑布係一圈套住禮服上衣衫袖。
modelNote.en: The 10 cm width follows p.162; “above the elbow” is modelled as 1 cm above it (no distance in the Handbook). The band goes right round the dress-jacket sleeve.

zh.name: 卓越服務勳章（掛頸）
zh.place: 繫喺頸上：綬帶由衣領兩邊落，勳章喺喉嚨下面（禮服、編號 4 喺領帶前面；編號 3、5、6 喺領巾同巾圈前面；晚禮服喺煲呔下面）。
zh.quote: 銅獅勳章、銀獅勳章、金獅勳章；青龍勳章、銀龍勳章、金龍勳章：繫在特定顏色的綬帶掛在頸上。假若獲頒多於一個勳章，只佩戴最高級的勳章。晚禮服：卓越服務勳章掛在頸上。
zh.conditions: 獅勳章頒予領袖及總監，龍勳章頒予會務委員；銅狼勳章由世界童軍委員會頒發，等級名單第 2 位（只低過英勇獎勵），係掛頸勳章入面最高級，有銅狼就只戴銅狼。同一時間只戴最高級一個（P.186）。

en.name: Distinguished service decoration (neck)
en.place: Round the neck: the ribbon comes down either side of the collar with the decoration below the throat (in front of the tie on the dress uniform and No. 4, in front of the neckerchief and woggle on Nos. 3, 5 and 6, below the bow tie on evening dress).
en.quote: Bronze, Silver and Gold Lion; Green, Silver and Gold Dragon: hung round the neck on the ribbon of its colour. If more than one is held, wear only the highest. Evening dress: the distinguished service decoration is worn round the neck.
en.conditions: Lions are awarded to scouters and commissioners, Dragons to lay members; the Bronze Wolf is awarded by the World Scout Committee, No. 2 in the order of precedence (below only gallantry awards) and the highest neck decoration — a holder wears only the Bronze Wolf. Wear only the highest one at a time (p.186).

modelNote.zh: 獅／龍勳章連 V 字綬帶相片取自手冊 P.178–179（已去背景）；銅狼勳章圖片由用戶提供。模型當一塊貼喺胸前（9 × 13 cm 入面按比例），唔係真係繞住條頸。
modelNote.en: The Lion/Dragon photos with their V ribbons are from Handbook pp.178–179 (background removed); the Bronze Wolf image was supplied by the user. The model lays it flat on the chest (scaled inside 9 × 13 cm) rather than wrapping it round the neck.

zh.name: 英勇獎勵
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章）。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置，圓形牌頂端緊貼袋蓋頂。假若佩戴兩個或以上獎章，則依「按等級排列的童軍勳章及獎勵名單」排列，順序由左至右（由內側至外側）佩戴。假若佩戴四個或以上獎章，用金屬胸針串連重疊起來佩戴，最高等級的獎章在最上面。假若在個別獎勵中獲頒多於一個獎章，只佩戴最高級的獎章。晚禮服：佩戴其他勳章及獎勵的小型章在右襟領童軍徽上方位置。
zh.conditions: 頒予童軍成員，表揚個人或團體不同程度嘅英勇表現；只戴最高級一個。P.191–192 等級第 1 位。

en.name: Gallantry award
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): centred above the right chest-pocket flap; evening dress: above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (miniature).
en.quote: Worn centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, the top of the round medal against the top of the flap. Two or more are arranged by the order of precedence, from left to right (inside to outside); four or more are joined by a metal brooch and overlapped, the highest on top. If more than one medal of the same award is held, wear only the highest. Evening dress: miniatures of the other awards go above the Scout emblem on the right lapel.
en.conditions: Recognises gallantry by individuals or groups; wear only the highest. No. 1 in the pp.191–192 order of precedence.

modelNote.zh: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：勳章排喺右胸袋袋蓋上方中央，由內側（近中線）至外側按 P.191–192 等級排列；兩至三個並排（Swing Mount），四個或以上用金屬胸針串連重疊、最高等級喺最上面，各勳章底部同一水平（P.193）。模型當圓形牌高 3.6 cm：勳章底喺袋蓋頂下 3.6 cm（圓形牌頂端貼住袋蓋頂）。晚禮服：小型章排喺右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章當一半大小，手冊冇寫尺寸）。勳章相片取自手冊 P.178–185（已去背景）。
modelNote.en: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): medals hang centred above the right chest-pocket flap, from the inside (centre line) outward in the pp.191–192 order of precedence; two or three side by side (swing mount), four or more joined by a metal brooch and overlapped with the highest on top, all bottoms level (p.193). The model takes the medal disc as 3.6 cm tall: the medal bottoms sit 3.6 cm below the top of the flap (disc top against the flap top). Evening dress: miniatures above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (taken as half size; no size in the Handbook). Medal photos from Handbook pp.178–185 (background removed).

zh.name: 功績榮譽獎勵
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章）。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置，圓形牌頂端緊貼袋蓋頂。假若佩戴兩個或以上獎章，則依「按等級排列的童軍勳章及獎勵名單」排列，順序由左至右（由內側至外側）佩戴。假若佩戴四個或以上獎章，用金屬胸針串連重疊起來佩戴，最高等級的獎章在最上面。假若在個別獎勵中獲頒多於一個獎章，只佩戴最高級的獎章。晚禮服：佩戴其他勳章及獎勵的小型章在右襟領童軍徽上方位置。
zh.conditions: 頒予成年成員，表揚長期對童軍運動不同程度嘅功績服務；只戴最高級一個。P.191–192 等級：功績榮譽十字章第 9、功績榮譽獎章第 11、優異服務獎章第 13、優良服務獎章第 14。

en.name: Meritorious service award
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): centred above the right chest-pocket flap; evening dress: above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (miniature).
en.quote: Worn centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, the top of the round medal against the top of the flap. Two or more are arranged by the order of precedence, from left to right (inside to outside); four or more are joined by a metal brooch and overlapped, the highest on top. If more than one medal of the same award is held, wear only the highest. Evening dress: miniatures of the other awards go above the Scout emblem on the right lapel.
en.conditions: For long and meritorious service by adults; wear only the highest. Precedence (pp.191–192): Cross No. 9, Medal No. 11, Distinguished Service No. 13, Good Service No. 14.

modelNote.zh: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：勳章排喺右胸袋袋蓋上方中央，由內側（近中線）至外側按 P.191–192 等級排列；兩至三個並排（Swing Mount），四個或以上用金屬胸針串連重疊、最高等級喺最上面，各勳章底部同一水平（P.193）。模型當圓形牌高 3.6 cm：勳章底喺袋蓋頂下 3.6 cm（圓形牌頂端貼住袋蓋頂）。晚禮服：小型章排喺右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章當一半大小，手冊冇寫尺寸）。勳章相片取自手冊 P.178–185（已去背景）。
modelNote.en: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): medals hang centred above the right chest-pocket flap, from the inside (centre line) outward in the pp.191–192 order of precedence; two or three side by side (swing mount), four or more joined by a metal brooch and overlapped with the highest on top, all bottoms level (p.193). The model takes the medal disc as 3.6 cm tall: the medal bottoms sit 3.6 cm below the top of the flap (disc top against the flap top). Evening dress: miniatures above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (taken as half size; no size in the Handbook). Medal photos from Handbook pp.178–185 (background removed).

zh.name: 鑽禧大露營紀念章
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章）。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置，圓形牌頂端緊貼袋蓋頂。假若佩戴兩個或以上獎章，則依「按等級排列的童軍勳章及獎勵名單」排列，順序由左至右（由內側至外側）佩戴。假若佩戴四個或以上獎章，用金屬胸針串連重疊起來佩戴，最高等級的獎章在最上面。假若在個別獎勵中獲頒多於一個獎章，只佩戴最高級的獎章。晚禮服：佩戴其他勳章及獎勵的小型章在右襟領童軍徽上方位置。
zh.conditions: 特別活動紀念徽章：頒予喺特別活動中有貢獻嘅成年成員。P.191–192 等級第 16 位。

en.name: Diamond Jubilee Jamboree Medal
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): centred above the right chest-pocket flap; evening dress: above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (miniature).
en.quote: Worn centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, the top of the round medal against the top of the flap. Two or more are arranged by the order of precedence, from left to right (inside to outside); four or more are joined by a metal brooch and overlapped, the highest on top. If more than one medal of the same award is held, wear only the highest. Evening dress: miniatures of the other awards go above the Scout emblem on the right lapel.
en.conditions: Special event commemorative medal for adults who contributed to the event. No. 16 in the pp.191–192 order of precedence.

modelNote.zh: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：勳章排喺右胸袋袋蓋上方中央，由內側（近中線）至外側按 P.191–192 等級排列；兩至三個並排（Swing Mount），四個或以上用金屬胸針串連重疊、最高等級喺最上面，各勳章底部同一水平（P.193）。模型當圓形牌高 3.6 cm：勳章底喺袋蓋頂下 3.6 cm（圓形牌頂端貼住袋蓋頂）。晚禮服：小型章排喺右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章當一半大小，手冊冇寫尺寸）。勳章相片取自手冊 P.178–185（已去背景）。
modelNote.en: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): medals hang centred above the right chest-pocket flap, from the inside (centre line) outward in the pp.191–192 order of precedence; two or three side by side (swing mount), four or more joined by a metal brooch and overlapped with the highest on top, all bottoms level (p.193). Evening dress: miniatures above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (taken as half size; no size in the Handbook). Medal photos from Handbook pp.178–185 (background removed).

zh.name: 香港童軍跨世紀大露營紀念章／星章
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章）。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置，圓形牌頂端緊貼袋蓋頂。假若佩戴兩個或以上獎章，則依「按等級排列的童軍勳章及獎勵名單」排列，順序由左至右（由內側至外側）佩戴。假若佩戴四個或以上獎章，用金屬胸針串連重疊起來佩戴，最高等級的獎章在最上面。假若在個別獎勵中獲頒多於一個獎章，只佩戴最高級的獎章。晚禮服：佩戴其他勳章及獎勵的小型章在右襟領童軍徽上方位置。
zh.conditions: 特別活動紀念徽章；星章或紀念章只戴一個。P.191–192 等級第 17 位。

en.name: Millennium Jamboree Medal / Star
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): centred above the right chest-pocket flap; evening dress: above the Scout emblem on the right lapel (miniature).
en.quote: Worn centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket, the top of the round medal against the top of the flap. en.conditions: Special event commemorative; wear either the star or the medal. No. 17 in the pp.191–192 order of precedence.

zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽上方（小型章）。

If both are held, wear only the High Commendation lanyard. Evening dress: the miniature lanyard runs under the left shoulder strap.
en.conditions: The Commendation goes to scouters and commissioners, the High Commendation to commissioners; if both are held wear only the High Commendation.

modelNote.zh: 笛繩用 3D 繩示意：嘉許 = 橙金色、高級嘉許 = 紫色主繩夾幼米白扭紋（v20 用戶指正）（P.184 相片顏色）；選單細圖係手冊 P.184 相片。路線（v19 用戶指正＋相片）：由左肩職級肩章（肩帶膊頭嗰頭）下面穿出，兜過袖頂前邊、沿袖窿前面吊落到胸袋下面，再兜返上左胸袋口近中線嗰邊；後面一段（v20）由肩章下面向後、沿袖窿後面落到腋下同前面接埋，成個圈套住左膊。晚禮服小型笛繩幼一半、一樣由肩章下面起，末端去到左襟領。
modelNote.en: The lanyard is a 3D cord: Commendation orange-gold, High Commendation purple with a thin cream twist (v20 user correction) (colours from the p.184 photos); the menu thumbnails are the p.184 photos. Route (v19 user correction with photo): out from under the rank slide at the shoulder end of the left strap, over the front of the sleeve top, down the front of the armhole to below the pocket, then back up to the inner side of the left pocket mouth; a back strand (v20) runs from under the rank slide down the back of the armhole to the armpit and joins the front, so the cord loops round the left shoulder. The evening-dress miniature is half as thick, also starts under the rank slide and ends at the left lapel.

zh.name: 香港總監感謝章
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：右胸袋袋蓋中央；晚禮服：右襟領童軍徽下面。
zh.quote: 香港總監感謝章佩戴在西服上衣右面翻領上；假若穿著制服，佩戴在恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋中央位置。晚禮服：佩戴香港總監感謝章在右襟領童軍徽下方位置。
zh.conditions: 頒予會務委員，表揚忠誠服務。

en.name: Chief Commissioner's Thanks Badge
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): centre of the right chest-pocket flap; evening dress: below the Scout emblem on the right lapel.
en.quote: The Thanks Badge goes on the right lapel of a suit; with uniform, centred on the right chest-pocket flap of the shirt or dress jacket. Evening dress: below the Scout emblem on the right lapel.
en.conditions: Awarded to lay members for loyal service.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 3 × 3 cm。相片取自手冊 P.184（已去背景）。禮服上同時戴勳章時，勳章圓形牌會蓋住部份感謝章（手冊冇講點避開）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 3 × 3 cm. Photo from Handbook p.184 (background removed). When medals are worn on the dress uniform too, the medals partly cover the Thanks Badge (the Handbook does not say how to avoid this).

zh.name: 民政及青年事務局局長嘉許
zh.place: 禮服同恤衫（編號 1、3–6）：左胸袋袋蓋右方（近中線嗰邊）；晚禮服：左襟領童軍徽下面。冇勳條，一般場合照戴。
zh.quote: 佩戴資格：1. 獲嘉許的青少年制服團體青年義務領袖（本會 35 歲或以下成年成員）；2. 獲嘉許的青少年制服團體義務領袖（本會成年成員）。佩戴方法：制服恤衫及禮服：佩戴在上衣左胸袋袋蓋右方位置。晚禮服：佩戴在上衣左襟領童軍徽下方位置。西服：佩戴在上衣左面翻領上。此項嘉許不設勳條。
zh.conditions: 民政及青年事務局局長嘉許計劃（政府頒授）：銀色＝青年義務領袖（35 歲或以下），金色＝義務領袖。手冊 P.198（2024-10-15 修訂）。

en.name: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs' Commendation
en.place: Dress jacket and shirts (Nos. 1, 3–6): right-hand side (towards the centre) of the left chest-pocket flap; evening dress: below the Scout emblem on the left lapel. No ribbon, so it is worn at general occasions too.
en.quote: Eligibility: 1. commended youth volunteer leaders of uniformed youth groups (adult members aged 35 or under); 2. commended volunteer leaders of uniformed youth groups (adult members). Wearing: uniform shirt and dress jacket — on the right-hand side of the left chest-pocket flap; evening dress — below the Scout emblem on the left lapel; lounge suit — on the left lapel. There is no ribbon for this commendation.
en.conditions: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs' Commendation Scheme (government award): silver = youth volunteer leader (35 or under), gold = volunteer leader. Handbook p.198 (revised 15 Oct 2024).

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用約 3.2 cm。相片取自手冊 P.198（已去背景）。同布質名牌一齊戴時會疊住名牌右邊少少（手冊冇講點避開）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses about 3.2 cm. Photo from Handbook p.198 (background removed). Worn with the cloth name tag it slightly overlaps the right end of the tag (the Handbook does not say how to avoid this).

zh.name: 獎章領袖標誌（榮譽童軍獎章／貝登堡獎章）
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同勳章或勳條一齊戴時喺佢哋上面；同和平使者章／紀念章並排時喺左（內側），同公教章並排時喺右（外側）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲榮譽童軍獎章／貝登堡獎章的成年成員可佩戴在制服上。榮譽童軍獎章領袖標誌與貝登堡獎章領袖標誌不能同時佩戴，同時考獲兩個獎章者，只能佩戴榮譽童軍獎章領袖標誌。佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與獎勵獎章或勳條一起佩戴，獎章領袖標誌在其上方位置。
zh.conditions: 以前做青少年成員時考獲支部最高獎章；兩個都有就只戴榮譽童軍獎章領袖標誌。

en.name: Award Leader Emblem (Hong Kong Scout Award / B.-P. Award)
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; above any medals or ribbons; left (inner side) of the Messengers of Peace / Commemorative Badge, right (outer side) of the Catholic Badge.
en.quote: Adults who earned the Hong Kong Scout Award / B.-P. Award may wear it. The two leader emblems may not be worn together; holders of both wear only the Hong Kong Scout Award Leader Emblem. Worn centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap; with medals or ribbons, the emblem goes above them.
en.conditions: Earned the section's highest award as a youth member; holders of both wear only the Hong Kong Scout Award emblem.

zh.name: 榮譽童軍獎章領袖標誌

en.name: Hong Kong Scout Award Leader Emblem

modelNote.zh: 即係成年成員嘅「支部最高獎章標誌」（手冊 P.134 嘅金紫荊／總領袖／榮譽童軍獎章標誌只為青少年成員而設）。手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 2 cm（P.135 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: This is the adult form of the section highest award emblem (the p.134 Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's / Hong Kong Scout Award emblems are for youth members only). No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 2 cm (p.135 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 成年成員公教章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同其他章並排時喺左（內側）；同勳章或勳條一齊戴時喺佢哋上面。
zh.quote: 已領洗的天主教成年成員可佩戴在制服上。佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與獎勵獎章或勳條一起佩戴，公教章在其上方位置。假若與榮譽童軍獎章領袖標誌／貝登堡獎章領袖標誌、和平使者章或紀念章一起佩戴，只可選擇其中一項並行排列佩戴；公教章在各章左方位置（內側）。
zh.conditions: 已領洗嘅天主教成年成員。

en.name: Adult Catholic Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; left (inner side) when worn beside another badge; above any medals or ribbons.
en.quote: Baptised Catholic adults may wear it, centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap; with medals or ribbons it goes above them. With the Award Leader Emblem, Messengers of Peace Badge or Commemorative Badge, only one of them may be worn beside it, the Catholic Badge on the left (inner side).
en.conditions: Baptised Catholic adults.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 cm（P.140 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 2.6 cm (p.140 proportions).

zh.name: 和平使者章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同紀念章並排時喺左（內側）；同勳章或勳條一齊戴時喺佢哋上面。
zh.quote: 童軍成員在參加已於「世界童軍組織」網站註冊及總會核准的和平使者計劃活動後，可佩戴在制服上。佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與勳條一起佩戴，和平使者章在其上方位置。假若與紀念章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，和平使者章在其左方位置。由活動首天起，可佩戴十二個月。
zh.conditions: 參加已註冊同核准嘅和平使者計劃活動；可戴 12 個月（再完成另一項可額外 12 個月）。

en.name: Messengers of Peace Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; left (inner side) of the Commemorative Badge; above any medals or ribbons.
en.quote: Members who take part in a Messengers of Peace project registered on the WOSM website and approved by the Association may wear it, centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap; above any ribbons; left of the Commemorative Badge. Worn for twelve months from the first day.
en.conditions: Registered and approved Messengers of Peace project; 12 months (another 12 after a further project).

zh.name: 紀念章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同其他章並排時喺右（外側）；同勳章或勳條一齊戴時喺佢哋上面。
zh.quote: 紀念章佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與其他標誌或徽章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，紀念章在其右方位置。紀念章最大尺寸以七釐米（闊）× 七釐米（高）為限。
zh.conditions: 只限已獲批准、喺指定期間內佩戴；同一時間只戴一個。

en.name: Commemorative Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap; right (outer side) beside another badge; above any medals or ribbons.
en.quote: Worn centred 3 cm above the right pocket flap. With another emblem or badge the two sit side by side, the Commemorative Badge on the right. At most 7 cm wide × 7 cm high.
en.conditions: Approved badges only, within the set period; one at a time.

modelNote.zh: 圖案係手冊示例色塊，每個紀念章唔同；模型用 5 × 5 cm（上限 7 × 7 cm）。
modelNote.en: The artwork is the handbook's example block; each badge differs. The model uses 5 × 5 cm (limit 7 × 7 cm).

zh.name: 飛行章／跳傘章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；飛行章同寰宇童軍章一齊戴時改喺 2 cm、寰宇童軍章喺上面；跳傘章同寰宇童軍章並排（跳傘章喺右）。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的深資童軍、樂行童軍及成年成員可佩戴在制服上。樂行童軍及成年成員佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。飛行章與跳傘章不可同時佩戴在制服上，只可選擇佩戴其中一項。
zh.conditions: 只可以戴其中一個。

en.name: Flying Badge / Parachute Badge
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's left pocket flap; with the Scouts of the World Award the Flying Badge moves to 2 cm with the award above it, while the Parachute Badge sits beside the award (Parachute on the right).
en.quote: Qualified Venture Scouts, Rover Scouts and adults may wear it. Rover Scouts and adults wear it centred 3 cm above the left pocket flap. The Flying and Parachute Badges may not be worn together.
en.conditions: Only one of the two.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自《樂行童軍支部訓練綱要》P.36（同手冊 P.150 一樣，較清晰）；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 5.5 cm 闊。
modelNote.en: Artwork from the Rover Scout Training Scheme p.36 (same as Handbook p.150, clearer); no size in the Handbook, the model uses 5.5 cm wide.

zh.name: 寰宇童軍章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm；同跳傘章並排時喺左；同飛行章一齊戴時喺飛行章上面。
zh.quote: 完成「世界童軍組織」寰宇童軍計劃的樂行童軍及成年成員可佩戴在制服上，直至年滿二十六歲為止。樂行童軍及成年成員佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置。假若與跳傘章一起佩戴，兩章並行排列，寰宇童軍章在其左方位置。假若與飛行章一起佩戴，飛行章佩戴在袋蓋上方二釐米中央位置，寰宇童軍章在其上方位置。
zh.conditions: 完成寰宇童軍計劃；戴到 26 歲為止。

en.name: Scouts of the World Award
en.place: 3 cm above the wearer's left pocket flap; left of the Parachute Badge; above the Flying Badge.
en.quote: Rover Scouts and adults who complete the WOSM Scouts of the World programme may wear it until age 26, centred 3 cm above the left pocket flap. With the Parachute Badge the two sit side by side, the award on the left. With the Flying Badge, the wings go 2 cm above the flap and the award above them.
en.conditions: Completed the Scouts of the World programme; until age 26.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自綱要 P.29（同手冊 P.154 一樣，較清晰）；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用直徑 5 cm。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Training Scheme p.29 (same as Handbook p.154, clearer); no size in the Handbook, the model uses 5 cm diameter.

zh.name: 香港青年獎勵計劃金章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方中央；同拯溺布章一齊戴時喺佢上面。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫左袖上方中央位置。成年成員只可佩戴金章，直至年滿二十五歲為止。
zh.conditions: 成年成員只可以戴金章；戴到 25 歲為止。

en.name: Hong Kong Award for Young People — Gold
en.place: Upper centre of the wearer's left sleeve; above the Life Saving Cloth Badge.
en.quote: Worn at the upper centre of the left sleeve. Adults may wear only the Gold Award, until age 25.
en.conditions: Adults wear only the Gold Award; until age 25.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自綱要 P.47（同手冊 P.157 一樣，較清晰）；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 3 cm。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Training Scheme p.47 (same as Handbook p.157, clearer); no size in the Handbook, the model uses 3 cm.

zh.name: 拯溺布章
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方中央；同香港青年獎勵計劃金章一齊戴時喺佢下面。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的童軍成員可佩戴在制服上，直至相關證書失效為止。佩戴在制服恤衫左袖上方中央位置。假若與香港青年獎勵計劃獎章一起佩戴，拯溺布章在其下方位置。
zh.conditions: 持有效拯溺資格；證書有效期內。

en.name: Life Saving Cloth Badge
en.place: Upper centre of the wearer's left sleeve; below the HKAYP Gold Award.
en.quote: Qualified members may wear it until the certificate expires, at the upper centre of the left sleeve; below the HKAYP Award when both are worn.
en.conditions: Valid life saving qualification; while valid.

zh.name: 世界榮譽童軍會（ATAS）標誌
zh.place: 穿著者左袖袖口縫線上方中央（服務段章下面）。
zh.quote: 已註冊為會員的樂行童軍／成年成員可佩戴在制服上。榮譽童軍獎章或同等獎章的持有人佩戴在樂行童軍或成年成員制服恤衫左袖縫線上方中央位置。貝登堡獎章或同等獎章的持有人佩戴在成年成員制服恤衫左袖縫線上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 已註冊為世界榮譽童軍會會員。

en.name: Association of Top Achiever Scouts (ATAS) Emblem
en.place: Centred just above the hem seam of the wearer's left sleeve (below any service bars).
en.quote: Registered Rover Scout / adult members may wear it. Holders of the Hong Kong Scout Award or B.-P. Award (or equivalent) wear it centred above the left sleeve seam of the uniform shirt.
en.conditions: Registered ATAS member.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 2.1 cm，喺服務段章（袖口縫線上方 3 cm 起）下面。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 2.1 cm, below the service bars (which start 3 cm above the hem seam).

notAllowed.zh: 著長褲（編號 6）唔可以戴深綠色金邊硬帽。
notAllowed.en: The dark green gold-edged hard hat may not be worn with trousers (No. 6).

notAllowed.zh: 總會總部章、地域章、區章只戴喺制服恤衫上（毛衣、禮服上衣只戴香港肩章／旅章）。
notAllowed.en: The Association Headquarters, Region and District Badges go only on the uniform shirt (the sweater and dress jacket carry only the Hong Kong shoulder title / Group Badge).

notAllowed.zh: 除獲得香港總監批准外，童軍單位嘅領巾唔可以用總會會巾嘅顏色。
notAllowed.en: Unless approved by the Chief Commissioner, a unit neckerchief may not use the colours of the Association neckerchief.

notAllowed.zh: 領巾尾喺肚臍附近，唔可以越過皮帶扣。
notAllowed.en: The neckerchief ends sit near the navel and may not pass the belt buckle.

notAllowed.zh: 唔可以喺晚禮服上戴木章；晚禮服唔需要佩上「R」字樣別針。
notAllowed.en: The Wood Badge is not worn on evening dress, nor the “R” pin.

notAllowed.zh: 禮服（編號 1）只可以戴世界童軍會員章、香港章、香港肩章／旅章、職級肩章，另可戴活動名牌、布質名牌、喪禮黑布、木章同已頒授嘅勳章及獎勵；唔可以戴其他章（包括地域章、區章、總會總部章、優異旅團章）。
notAllowed.en: The dress uniform (No. 1) carries only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge, Hong Kong shoulder title / Group Badge and rank epaulettes, plus optionally the activity name badge, cloth name tag, mourning band, Wood Badge and awarded decorations; no other badges (including the Region, District, Association Headquarters and Meritorious Group Badges).

notAllowed.zh: 晚禮服（編號 2）唔戴任何布章、領巾或領帶；只可以戴金屬職級肩章、黑色硬帽連銀色帽章，同埋可選嘅小型勳章、嘉許小型笛繩、感謝章；附加配件（眼鏡、手錶、結婚戒指除外）唔適用；唔可以戴木章同模範童軍肩帶。
notAllowed.en: Evening dress (No. 2) carries no cloth badges, neckerchief or tie; only the metal rank epaulettes and black hard hat with silver cap badge, plus optionally miniature decorations, the miniature commendation lanyard and the Thanks Badge; accessories (except glasses, watch and wedding ring) do not apply; no Wood Badge or Chief Scout's Award sash.

notAllowed.zh: 童軍禮服同晚禮服只有一款：海童軍、空童軍領袖都著同一款（帽、衫褲顏色一樣；用戶確認）。
notAllowed.en: There is only one Scout dress uniform and one evening dress: Sea and Air Scout leaders wear the same (same hats and colours; user confirmed).

notAllowed.zh: 制服編號 1a（夏季禮服）由 2014-11-01 起取消（過渡期至 2019-10-31），模型冇做。
notAllowed.en: Uniform No. 1a (summer dress) was abolished from 1 Nov 2014 (transition to 31 Oct 2019) and is not modelled.

notAllowed.zh: 工蜂章（手冊 P.130–131，右胸袋袋蓋中央）同感謝章同一個位置，未有示範。
notAllowed.en: The Worker Bee badge (Handbook pp.130–131, centre of the right pocket flap) shares the Thanks Badge position and is not shown.

uninvested.zh: 成年成員制服按已宣誓處理（會員章、領巾、帽都戴）；模型唔提供未宣誓狀態。
uninvested.en: Adult uniforms are shown as invested (membership badge, neckerchief and cap worn); the model has no uninvested state.

conflicts.zh: 職級英文名係描述性翻譯（中文版手冊冇英文名），請以總會英文文件為準。
conflicts.en: The English rank names are descriptive translations (the Chinese Handbook has none); follow SAHK's English documents.

conflicts.zh: 職級肩章、香港肩章、總會總部章手冊冇寫尺寸：模型按圖案比例同 P.172 附圖估計。

conflicts.en: Handbook p.93: Rover Scouts and adults wear the Hong Kong Badge centred on the right pocket; only the youth sections (Cub, Scout, Venture) wear it above the left flap.

conflicts.zh: P.191–192（第 24/2025 號通告）等級名單有 32 項；模型提供手冊 P.178–185 有相片（同勳條）嘅：英勇、銅狼（用戶提供圖片）、獅／龍、功績榮譽十字章、功績榮譽獎章、優異／優良服務獎章、鑽禧、跨世紀、大都會、百周年、童軍中心、95 周年及百周年特別貢獻、特殊貢獻星章／徽章、長期服務；另加用戶 v19 提供官方參考圖嘅 110 周年紀念章（銀第 20 位、銅第 30 位）、童心抗疫徽章（第 21 位）、同行未來大露營紀念章（第 22 位）、110 周年特別貢獻章（第 26 位，唔分星數）。已逐頁睇過 P.177–200（v17）：110 周年紀念星章唔喺名單、用戶決定唔加；亞太區童軍基金冇相，唔加；其他童軍會、英國童軍會、世界／亞太區委員會獎勵亦冇相。
conflicts.en: The pp.191–192 order of precedence (Circular 24/2025) lists 32 items; the model provides those with a photo (and ribbon) on Handbook pp.178–185: gallantry, Bronze Wolf (image supplied by the user), Lions/Dragons, Cross and Medal of Merit, Distinguished and Good Service Medals, Diamond Jubilee, Millennium, Metro Camp, Centenary, Scout Centre, 95th and Centenary Special Contribution, Special Contribution Star/medallions and long service; plus, from official reference images the user supplied in v19, the 110th Anniversary Medallion (silver No. 20, bronze No. 30), the Scout Health Guard Medallion (No. 21), the Walk Together Jamboree Medallion (No. 22) and the 110th Anniversary Special Contribution Medallion (No. 26, grades not distinguished). Pages 177–200 were checked one by one (v17): the 110th Anniversary Star Medallion is not on the list and the user decided not to add it; the APR Scout Foundation award has no photo and is not added; awards of other associations, The Scout Association (UK) and the World/APR Committees have no photo either.

conflicts.zh: 政府／非童軍機構／海外童軍會頒授嘅勳章戴喺左胸袋上方（P.196–200）；模範童軍肩帶或紅笛同嘉許笛繩只可以揀一樣戴（P.158、P.197）：模型未有呢幾項（民政及青年事務局局長嘉許 P.198 已加）。
conflicts.en: Government, non-Scout and overseas association awards go above the left pocket (pp.196–200); a King's Scout cord or red lanyard and a commendation lanyard are worn one or the other (pp.158, 197): the model does not include these yet (the Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs' Commendation, p.198, is included).

zh.name: 一般場合：勳條
zh.place: 制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央；每行三個，多過三個就喺上面開新一行並置中；由內側（佩戴者左）至外側（佩戴者右）按等級排列。
zh.quote: 童軍成員出席一般場合，可在制服上佩戴勳條。佩戴所有勳章及獎勵的勳條在制服恤衫或禮服上衣右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置；長期服務獎勵只佩戴最高年資的勳條。依第 191 至 192 頁「按等級排列的童軍勳章及獎勵名單」排列，順序由左至右（由內側至外側）佩戴。用金屬胸針順序由左至右串連起來佩戴。每行三個勳條；否則在上方開新一行並置中對齊。勳條與勳章及獎勵不可同時佩戴。假若穿西服，不可佩戴勳條。
zh.conditions: 一般場合指日常活動及訓練。香港總監嘉許／高級嘉許笛繩、感謝章（P.188）同服務段章（P.189）照戴。晚禮服係重要禮儀場合穿著，冇勳條。手冊 P.195 例子：多出嚟嗰幾個（最高等級）喺最上面一行。

en.name: General occasions: ribbons
en.place: Centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket; three per row, extra rows above and centred; ordered from inside (wearer's left) to outside (wearer's right) by precedence.
en.quote: At general occasions members may wear ribbons on the uniform. Ribbons of all decorations and awards are worn centred above the right chest-pocket flap of the uniform shirt or dress jacket; for long service only the ribbon of the longest service is worn. They follow the order of precedence on pp.191–192, from left to right (inside to outside), joined left to right on a metal brooch. Three ribbons per row; otherwise a new row is started above and centred. Ribbons are not worn together with decorations and medals, and not on a lounge suit.
en.conditions: General occasions are everyday activities and training. The Chief Commissioner's commendation lanyards, thanks badge (p.188) and service bars (p.189) are still worn. Evening dress is for formal occasions and has no ribbons. Handbook p.195 examples: the extra (highest) ribbons form the top row.

pocketR.zh: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方 3 cm（上層）：公教章、獎章領袖標誌、和平使者章、紀念章最多揀兩個並排，排先嘅喺左（內側）；同勳章或勳條一齊戴時喺佢哋上面（手冊 P.135–136、P.140、P.164–165）。
pocketR.en: 3 cm above the wearer's right pocket flap (upper row): up to two of the Catholic Badge, Award Leader Emblem, Messengers of Peace Badge and Commemorative Badge side by side, the earlier one on the left (inner side); above any medals or ribbons (Handbook pp.135–136, 140, 164–165).

pocketL.en: Above the wearer's left pocket flap: the Flying, Parachute or Scouts of the World badge alone sits 3 cm above the flap; the Parachute Badge and Scouts of the World Award sit side by side (Parachute on the right, inner side); with the Flying Badge and the Scouts of the World Award, the wings go 2 cm above the flap and the award above them (Handbook pp.150, 154, 166–167).
